title: Initiatives View
audit_note: All 14 implementation steps completed. API client with full CRUD (createInitiative, updateInitiative, deleteInitiative, reorderInitiatives). TypeScript types (InitiativeStatus, PlanCounts, InitiativeWithPlanCounts, InitiativeWithPlans). Custom components: ColorPicker (6 preset colors), IconPicker (emoji grid). InitiativeCard showing icon, name, description preview, status badge, plan counts. InitiativeModal for create/edit with form validation. InitiativesListPage with drag-drop reorder via @dnd-kit, status filtering, empty state. InitiativeDetailPage with full details, actions menu, plans list. Routes /initiatives and /initiatives/:id added to App.tsx. Skeleton component for loading states. Tests for components and pages all passing.

summary.goal: Create dedicated view to list, create, and manage initiatives
summary.context: Initiatives group related plans. This view provides CRUD for initiatives and shows aggregate stats (plan counts by status, progress). Accessible via sidebar 'Initiatives' link or clicking section header.

acceptance_criteria.description: Route /initiatives shows all initiatives in card grid
Each initiative card shows: icon, name, description preview, status badge
Each initiative card shows plan counts: total, draft, approved, published
Initiative cards are clickable, navigate to /initiatives/:id (initiative detail)
Initiative detail view shows full description, all plans in list, edit/archive actions
New Initiative modal: name (required), description (optional), icon picker, color picker
Edit Initiative modal: same fields as create, plus archive action
Filter by status: active, completed, archived
Empty state when no initiatives: prompt to create first
Drag-drop reorder initiatives (persists order)

views.name: Initiatives List
views.layout: responsive card grid, 3 cols desktop, 2 cols tablet, 1 col mobile

elements.props: status filter Select, New Initiative Button
emoji/icon with color bg, font-display font-semibold

steps.title: Extend initiatives API client with CRUD operations
steps.description: Add API client functions to src/api/initiatives.ts for full CRUD: createInitiative, updateInitiative, deleteInitiative, reorderInitiatives. Export from src/api/index.ts. These consume backend endpoints from schema-org-initiative.

acceptance_criteria.description: createInitiative({ name, description?, icon?, color? }) returns Promise<{ initiative: Initiative }>
updateInitiative(id, { name?, description?, icon?, color?, status? }) returns Promise<{ initiative: Initiative }>
deleteInitiative(id) returns Promise<void> (archives via status='archived')
reorderInitiatives(ids: string[]) returns Promise<void> (sets display_order)
All functions exported from src/api/index.ts

steps.notes: listInitiatives and getInitiative already added by ui-sidebar-layout feature

custom_components: InitiativeCard - Card variant with icon, stats bar, status badge
IconPicker - Grid of emoji/icons, click to select
ColorPicker - Preset color swatches (cyan, purple, green, orange, pink, yellow)

steps.title: Add Initiative TypeScript types
steps.description: Add/extend Initiative types in src/types.ts to match backend schema. Include InitiativeStatus enum, PlanCounts type for stats.

acceptance_criteria.description: InitiativeStatus = 'active' | 'completed' | 'archived'
PlanCounts = { total: number, draft: number, approved: number, published: number }
Initiative type includes: initiative_id, org_id, name, description?, status, icon?, color?, display_order, plan_count or plan_counts, created_at, updated_at
InitiativeWithPlans extends Initiative with plans: PlanSummary[]

steps.title: Create useInitiative hook for single initiative
steps.description: Create src/hooks/useInitiative.ts that fetches a single initiative with its plans. Handles loading, error, refetch.

acceptance_criteria.description: useInitiative(id) returns { initiative: InitiativeWithPlans | null, isLoading, error, refetch }
Calls getInitiative(id) which returns initiative with nested plans array
Hook exported from src/hooks/index.ts

steps.title: Create ColorPicker component
steps.description: Create src/components/ColorPicker.tsx with preset color swatches matching design system. Grid of clickable swatches, selected state shown with ring.

acceptance_criteria.description: ColorPicker accepts { value, onChange, className? } props
Renders 6 preset colors: cyan (#00d9ff), purple (#a855f7), green (#00ffc8), orange (#ff6b35), pink (#f472b6), yellow (#facc15)
Each swatch is 24x24px circle, arranged in row with gap-2
Selected swatch has ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-bg-card
Clicking swatch calls onChange(colorHex)

steps.title: Create IconPicker component
steps.description: Create src/components/IconPicker.tsx with grid of emoji/icons to select. Includes common initiative emojis and option to type custom emoji.

acceptance_criteria.description: IconPicker accepts { value, onChange, className? } props
Renders grid of 12-16 preset emojis: rocket, target, flag, star, lightning, folder, briefcase, chart, etc.
Each emoji button is 32x32px with hover:bg-bg-tertiary
Selected emoji has bg-accent-cyan/10 border-accent-cyan ring
Small input below grid allows typing custom emoji
Clicking emoji or typing in input calls onChange(emoji)

steps.title: Create InitiativeCard component
steps.description: Create src/components/InitiativeCard.tsx per design_spec. Shows icon with color bg, name, description preview, status badge, plan counts stats bar. Clickable, navigates to detail view.

acceptance_criteria.description: InitiativeCard accepts { initiative: Initiative, className? } props
Header row: icon (32x32 rounded bg with emoji), name (font-display font-semibold truncate)
Description: text-text-secondary text-sm line-clamp-2, min-h to prevent layout shift
Stats bar: row of counts - total plans, draft, approved, published with colored dots
Status badge: active=accent-green, completed=accent-cyan, archived=text-muted
Card: bg-bg-card border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-4 hover:border-border-default transition-all cursor-pointer
Wraps in Link to /initiatives/{initiative_id}

steps.title: Create InitiativeModal component
steps.description: Create src/components/InitiativeModal.tsx for create/edit. Uses Dialog from design system. Form with name input, description textarea, IconPicker, ColorPicker. Submit button, loading state.

acceptance_criteria.description: InitiativeModal accepts { open, onOpenChange, initiative?, onSuccess } props
If initiative prop provided, populates form for edit mode, title='Edit Initiative'
If no initiative, create mode, title='New Initiative'
Form fields: name (required, autofocus), description (optional, Textarea 3 rows), icon (IconPicker), color (ColorPicker)
Submit calls createInitiative or updateInitiative, shows loading spinner, calls onSuccess on completion
Cancel button closes modal without action
Form validation: name required, min 1 char

steps.title: Create InitiativesListPage component
steps.description: Create src/pages/InitiativesListPage.tsx showing all initiatives in responsive grid. Header with title, New Initiative button, status filter. Empty state when no initiatives.

acceptance_criteria.description: Page header: 'Initiatives' title, description, New Initiative button (opens modal)
Filter row: status filter (All, Active, Completed, Archived) as button group
Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4
Each initiative rendered with InitiativeCard
Loading state: skeleton grid of 6 cards
Empty state: centered message with TargetIcon, 'No initiatives yet', 'Create your first initiative' button
Uses useInitiatives hook from ui-sidebar-layout

steps.title: Create InitiativeDetailPage component
steps.description: Create src/pages/InitiativeDetailPage.tsx showing single initiative detail. Header with icon, name, edit/archive actions. Full description. Plans list using PlanCard.

acceptance_criteria.description: Header: large icon (48x48 with color bg), name (text-2xl font-display), status badge
Actions: Edit button (opens InitiativeModal in edit mode), dropdown with Archive option
Description section: full text with prose formatting if description exists
Plans section: 'Plans in this Initiative' heading with count, list of PlanCard components
Empty plans state: 'No plans in this initiative yet', link to create plan with initiative pre-selected
Loading state: skeleton for header + plan cards
Archive action: confirms, calls deleteInitiative (sets status=archived), navigates to /initiatives
Uses useInitiative(id) hook

steps.title: Add routes for initiatives pages
steps.description: Add routes to React Router config: /initiatives -> InitiativesListPage, /initiatives/:id -> InitiativeDetailPage.

acceptance_criteria.description: Route /initiatives renders InitiativesListPage within Layout
Route /initiatives/:id renders InitiativeDetailPage within Layout
Routes lazy-loaded for code splitting
Sidebar navigation link to /initiatives works

steps.title: Add drag-drop reorder for initiatives
steps.description: Add drag-drop reordering to InitiativesListPage using @dnd-kit. Reorder persists via reorderInitiatives API call.

acceptance_criteria.description: @dnd-kit/core and @dnd-kit/sortable installed in package.json
InitiativesListPage wraps grid in DndContext with SortableContext
Each InitiativeCard wrapped in useSortable for drag handle
Drag indicator: grab cursor, slight lift on drag, drop preview
onDragEnd calls reorderInitiatives(newOrder) with initiative IDs in new order
Optimistic update: reorder locally before API confirms
Error handling: revert to original order if API fails, show toast

steps.title: Create InitiativeCardSkeleton component
steps.description: Create skeleton loading state component matching InitiativeCard dimensions for smooth loading experience.

acceptance_criteria.description: InitiativeCardSkeleton matches InitiativeCard dimensions (same padding, border-radius)
Animated shimmer effect using bg-bg-tertiary with pulse animation
Skeleton shapes: icon circle, name bar, description lines, stats row
Exported alongside InitiativeCard for use in loading states

steps.description: Add tests for InitiativesListPage and InitiativeDetailPage. Cover loading, error, empty states, filtering, navigation.

steps.notes: Button in header with + icon, uses primary cyan styling, clearly visible
